The '''Industrial District''', also known as the '''Industrial Zone''',<ref name="Episode Guide" /> was a district of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It was the location of some of the largest [[Factory/Legends|factories]] in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], where [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[Foodstuff/Legends|foodstuff]], and [[Starship/Legends|starship]] parts were produced. The Industrial District was the site of giant packing plants, where [[Nerf/Legends|nerfs]] and other [[Species/Legends|species]] of livestock from across the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] were [[Death/Legends|slaughtered]], processed, and [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|carbon-frozen]] for distribution to thousands of [[Star system/Legends|star systems]]. Organized crime often used these businesses as legitimate fronts: [[Haugg Nerf Industries]] served as a front for the organization of [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Groff Haugg]].<ref name="Bounty Hunter" /> The Industrial District also contained the [[Coruscant Industrial Zone Detention Center/Legends|Coruscant Industrial Zone Detention Center]].<ref name="Episode Guide" />

In the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] [[Mission to Coruscant (The Hunt)|infiltrated]] Haugg Nerf Industries to question Haugg on [[Gender/Legends|his]] connections to the [[Bando Gora/Legends|Bando Gora]] cult.<ref name="Bounty Hunter" /> By the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="Evil Plans Date">{{TCWdates|308}}</ref> the bounty hunter [[Cad Bane/Legends|Cad Bane]] was using the Coruscant Industrial Zone [[Prison/Legends|Detention Center]] as a hideout.<ref name="Evil Plans">{{TCW|Evil Plans}}</ref>
